title: AlphaGo's move 37 had a 1 in 10,000 chance
summary: In game two of a March 2016 match, AlphaGo played move 37, which sources say had a 1 in 10,000 chance of being played by a human. It won the game and the match 4 to 1.

beats.say: AlphaGo's move thirty seven had a one in ten thousand chance.
In March two thousand sixteen, AlphaGo played a five game Go match in Seoul.
Months earlier, in October twenty fifteen, it had beaten the European champion five to nothing.
In game two, AlphaGo played move thirty seven.
Sources put the odds of a human playing it at one in ten thousand.
The move helped AlphaGo win that game.
AlphaGo won the match four games to one.
A rare move is not the same as a bad move.
The odds were one in ten thousand. The game was won.
A move almost no human would try became part of a win.
